summary: Viewers reacted with a mix of amusement and cautionary advice regarding the GTA 6 stock speculation, frequently debating whether market expectations are already priced into Take-Two equity. Several critics highlighted the extreme downside risk of potential game release delays. Audience members praised the polished motion graphics and inquired about hedging strategies and future trailer release timing.
